name: w6800
description: AMD Radeon Pro W6800 (Navi 21, RDNA 2, gfx1030) at its 2320 MHz clock: one Vortex core per CU; the CU is the RX 6600's (rx6600).

sources.CU (all core knobs): Inherited from rx6600: Navi 21 and Navi 23 share the RDNA 2 CU
sources.NUM_CORES: 60 CUs (30 DCUs), 3840 stream processors (Bao et al., NaviSim: A Highly Accurate GPU Simulator for AMD RDNA GPUs (PACT 2022), Table 1; Radeon Pro W6800 specifications)
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_BANKS: 4 MB L2 (Navi 21), 16-way, one bank per memory channel
sources.L3_SIZE, L3_NUM_BANKS: 128 MB Infinity Cache (Navi 21) behind the L2, the Vortex L3, one bank per memory channel
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_TYPE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_NU: 256-bit GDDR6 at 16 Gbps: 8 devices x 2 x16 channels = 16 channels, 16 x 2 B x 16 GT/s = 512 GB/s (Bao et al., NaviSim: A Highly Accurate GPU Simulator for AMD RDNA GPUs (PACT 2022), Table 1)
sources.PLATFORM_CLOCK_RATE: 2320 MHz, the core clock NaviSim validates at (Bao et al., NaviSim: A Highly Accurate GPU Simulator for AMD RDNA GPUs (PACT 2022), Table 1)
sources.reference: fp32_lanes is the vendor FP32 core count (FP32 FMA lanes per chip, clock-free); dram_bandwidth_gbs the vendor peak. Checked by ci/profile_check.py. NaviSim validates its RDNA model against this card (Bao et al., NaviSim: A Highly Accurate GPU Simulator for AMD RDNA GPUs (PACT 2022)); no cycle latencies are published, so the chase metrics are unchecked
